name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_get_message_map
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::GetMessageMap returns the dialog's typed MFC message-map record and the map entries route to the recovered handlers.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43dcc0 validates the function returns the static message-map address. Data at 0x4d1918/0x4d1920 validates a base-map getter pointer, 25 AFX_MSGMAP_ENTRY records, and a zero sentinel, with entries for WM_TIMER, WM_DESTROY, browse-record double-click, and the query edit EN_KILLFOCUS handlers.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_get_message_map_smoke verifies GetMessageMap returns WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::messageMap, the map points at messageEntries, the timer/destroy/browse-record and edit kill-focus entries carry the expected messages, notification codes, IDs, signatures, and member handlers, and entry 25 is the sentinel.
